meta.title: AI Gijinka · Shared Impressions, Individual Personas
meta.description:
world contains how others see a character: names, visual cues, common nicknames and memes. persona contains her own temperament, preferences and personal memories. The current character can recognize the others; setting and relationships remain yours to develop. Fourteen model families have basic text profiles.

Edit through conversation: “Add that community impression to world”, “Make the dragon persona more playful and save it”, or “Create Stella with this description and bind the current model.” The AI uses persona_edit / persona_manage to save. Successful saves update the relevant cache for the next request without a restart.

Versions within a family share one persona and memory. Existing connected model aliases can be bound to custom characters; inference providers are configured in DSH Settings.

instructions/README.md is included in the plugin prompt. External file edits use one targeted content reload; normal chat reuses cached text. /persona shows the role, /persona world shows shared material, and /persona help explains editing. Disabling allowAgentWrite removes conversational editing tools.

1.6.1 revises the content. User-edited files are preserved during upgrades and can be integrated with the new drafts through conversation.
